*Source: [The City of 7 Seraphs](https://www.drivethrurpg.com/product/269801/The-City-of-7-Seraphs?affiliate_id=549120)*

The following are new Mesmerist Bold Stares often used in the city. Some of these insights are particularly common to members of one organization, and are marked as such, but these abilities are not restricted to members of that organization.

---

#### False Hope [Children of Dreams]

The target counts as a willing target for the mesmerist's tricks, collective (if he has that ability), and spells that only function on willing targets. If the target would otherwise be unwilling, it gets a Will save to negate each such spell. Even if it fails, the creature has a 50% chance of ignoring the effect of such a spell or trick for 1 round at the start of its turn each round. If a mesmerist with the collective ability forces an unwilling creature into his collective this way, that creature gets a Will saving throw (DC 10 + 1/2 mesmerist's level + mesmerist's Charisma modifier) to negate being added and gets another saving throw to leave every 24 hours thereafter and before being affected by each effect directed at it through the collective.
